decision_provenance: Abdel Babiker authorised this task as the sole authority for completing the release.

defect.description: The predecessor generated category identifiers before lowercasing source labels, so capital letters were replaced by underscores. Head became _ead and Muscle injury became _uscle_injury. The family function therefore classified every injury type as Review required. The predecessor family roll-up also divided known days lost by every Time Loss injury, including injuries with unknown duration.

correction_rule.body_location_and_injury_type: Match the exact case-insensitive source label to one active controlled code or label in curated.code_lists. Unmatched labels are represented by the controlled Unknown code and label; their original labels remain unchanged in the immutable V3 source rows.
correction_rule.diagnosis_identifier: Generate the stable identifier only after lowercasing the retained diagnosis label.
correction_rule.family_mean_severity: Pool the known-duration Time Loss denominator represented by each subtype mean, then divide pooled known days lost by that denominator. Unknown-duration Time Loss injuries remain in family injury counts but not the severity denominator.
correction_rule.scientific_boundary: The correction changes reporting identifiers, controlled reporting labels for unmapped values, family assignment, and the family mean-severity denominator only. It does not infer a clinical category or change the immutable source label, cohort membership, classification, duration, exposure, injury counts, or days lost.
